title: Cross-paradigm audit of large language model judges for clinical text evaluation

zh_title: 临床文本评估中大语言模型评审者的跨范式审计
summary: 以专家评审为参照，审计 6 个开放权重模型在 4 个德语临床数据集上的评审可靠性与偏差。
key_points: 覆盖报告、护理记录、出院小结与患者信四类语料
无任一提示配置在各范式下与专家稳定对齐
替换专家后 57.2% 评分类别改变、漏检 10.2% 错误
reason: 多数据集并以专家评审为外部参照，揭示 LLM 评审系统性偏差，属重要档
abstract: Large language models are increasingly being used to evaluate clinical texts, a concept known as LLM-as-a-judge. However, most of the existing evidence focuses on English data and uses pooled agreement metrics that obscure clinically relevant failure modes. This study audited six open-weight models against expert judges on four German clinical datasets covering report and nursing documentation summarization, discharge summary generation, and patient letter generation. The models were evaluated across three paradigms and four prompt configurations. Alignment with experts varied by criterion and corpus, and no configuration proved reliable across paradigms. All judges exhibited position and identity bias. Substituting LLM-as-a-judge for the expert panel shifted 57.2% of pointwise categories, swapped 41.7% of pairwise winners, missed 10.2% of clinical errors, and inverted clinical priorities by overrating the criteria succinct and accurate. Therefore, LLM-as-a-judge is not a safe substitute for experts in German clinical text evaluations, and deployment thresholds should follow decision-impact analysis for LLM-as-a-judge in clinical contexts.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型正越来越多地被用于评估临床文本，这一概念被称为 LLM-as-a-judge。然而，现有证据大多集中于英文数据，并使用会掩盖临床相关失效模式的汇总一致性指标。本研究以专家评审为对照，审计了六个开放权重模型在四个德语临床数据集上的表现，这些数据集涵盖报告和护理文书摘要、出院摘要生成以及患者信件生成。模型在三种范式和四种提示配置下接受评估。与专家的一致性因标准和语料库而异，且没有任何配置在所有范式中均被证明可靠。所有评审模型都表现出位置偏差和身份偏差。以 LLM-as-a-judge 替代专家小组，使 57.2% 的逐点评分类别发生改变，调换了 41.7% 的成对比较优胜者，漏掉 10.2% 的临床错误，并因高估“简洁”和“准确”这两个标准而颠倒了临床优先级。因此，在德语临床文本评估中，LLM-as-a-judge 不是专家的安全替代品；部署阈值应遵循针对临床情境中 LLM-as-a-judge 的决策影响分析。

title: External Validation of a Machine Learning Model for Delirium Risk.

abstract: [JAMA network open] Although external validation of machine learning (ML)-based delirium risk models is a key stage in the model development pipeline, few published reports exist. Moreover, ML-based delirium risk models commonly degrade in performance during external validation. To examine the performance of a fusion multimodal with natural language processing (NLP) delirium risk stratification model in live clinical practice with cross-hospital external validation. This quality improvement study evaluated live clinical deployment of the model among patients 60 years or older who were admitted to non-intensive care units at Mount Sinai Hospital (MSH), with external validation performed at Mount Sinai Morningside Hospital (MSM), from December 1, 2024, to December 31, 2025. Primary outcomes were performance of the risk stratification model, assessed by area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), and monthly delirium detection rates. A 2 × 2 confusion matrix was created, and the 4 cells were used to calculate model performance metrics and compare associated diagnostic yield between premodel deployment and active model deployment periods. The overall sample included 33 095 admissions to non-intensive care units at MSM and MSH (mean [SD] age, 74.86 (9.22) years; 15 601 women [47.1%], 17 271 men [52.2%]). A total of 9020 MSM inpatient admissions were assigned a delirium risk score by the risk stratification model during live clinical operations and were compared to 21 186 MSH inpatient admissions that were assigned a risk score by the same model. Age at admission significantly differed between patients at MSM and MSH (MSM: median [IQR] age, 75.79 [68.25-83.88] years vs MSH: 72.62 [66.64-79.65] years; P < .001). Patients from MSM and MSH also significantly differed by sex, race and ethnicity, surgical vs medical primary diagnosis, length of stay, and dementia prevalence rate. Among 11 909 MSM patients, patients in the pre-ML cohort (median [IQR] age, 78.00 [71.00-85.00] years) were significantly older than those in the post-ML cohort (median [IQR] age, 75.79 [68.25-83.88] years) (P < .001). The AUROC of the model was 0.91 (95% CI, 0.90-0.92) for MSM and 0.94 (95% CI, 0.93-0.94) for MSH. The positive predictive value of the model was 25.9% for MSM and 19.4% for MSH. For MSM, the mean monthly delirium detection rate significantly increased from 9.23% (95% CI, 8.07%-10.38%) to 19.59% (95% CI, 17.32%-21.85%) after model deployment (P < .001). title: A Primer on Radiomics for the Practicing Orthopaedic Surgeon.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews
zh_title: 放射组学入门：写给执业骨科医生
summary: 面向骨科医生的入门综述，介绍放射组学等AI方法在影像分析与临床决策支持中的应用。
key_points: 涵盖计算机视觉、语言模型、预测分析等子领域
影像放射组学用于提取定量特征
模型可预测术后结局、住院时长与并发症
reason: 面向外科医生的入门综述，无新数据与新方法，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews] Artificial intelligence (AI) is permeating many aspects of daily life. Medicine, and specifically orthopaedic surgery, is being influenced by the rapid growth and success of AI in serving as an adjunct to medical expertise. AI includes many nested subfields and applications such as computer vision, language models, and predictive analytics. Using standard machine learning methods, clinical decision support tools are being developed for clinicians to provide evidence-based, individualized care. Some models predict clinical and functional outcomes after a procedure, whereas others may incorporate administrative metrics to predict factors, such as length of stay, return to the emergency department, and complications. The application of AI to medical imaging focuses on the extraction of a large amount of quantitative data in the form of predefined features from clinical images that humans cannot perceive, a field known as radiomics. There has been recent interest, particularly in oncology, to apply radiomics to aid in diagnosis and prognostication of outcomes. Given the robust growth of radiomics literature, and the anticipated application in orthopaedic surgery, the purpose of this review article is to educate the orthopaedic surgery community on the practical importance and the basics of radiomics.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. Global research & reviews] 人工智能（AI）正在渗透日常生活的许多方面。医学，尤其是骨科手术，正受到AI快速发展和成功作为医学专业能力辅助手段的影响。AI包括许多嵌套的子领域和应用，如计算机视觉、语言模型和预测分析。使用标准机器学习方法，正在为临床医生开发临床决策支持工具，以提供循证、个体化诊疗。一些模型预测某项操作后的临床和功能结局，而另一些模型可能纳入管理指标来预测诸如住院时间、重返急诊科和并发症等因素。AI在医学影像中的应用侧重于从临床图像中提取大量以预定义特征形式存在的、人类无法感知的定量数据，这一领域称为放射组学。近期尤其肿瘤学领域有兴趣应用放射组学来辅助诊断和预后判断。鉴于放射组学文献的强劲增长，以及其在骨科手术中的预期应用，本综述文章的目的是让骨科手术界了解放射组学的实际重要性和基础知识。

title: Cross-cancer knowledge transfer for lymph node metastasis prediction: Applicability of an axillary lymph node-based deep learning model
zh_title: 跨癌种知识迁移预测淋巴结转移
summary: 预印本用乳腺癌腋窝淋巴结CT训练DenseNet-121集成模型，在256例其他原发癌淋巴结外部数据上测试跨解剖泛化。
key_points: 训练集为523例乳腺癌患者1128个腋窝淋巴结
采用固定裁剪与可调方形裁剪结合的集成策略
外部测试集仅256例CT图像
reason: 有跨解剖外部验证但样本量有限、为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Evaluation of lymph node (LN) metastasis is critical for cancer staging and treatment planning. Since radiologic hallmarks of metastatic LNs are shared across primary cancers, a computed tomography (CT)-based deep learning (DL) classifier developed from one anatomy may transfer to others. This study built a DenseNet-121 ensemble model using clinical-implication-applied preprocessing and evaluated its cross-anatomical generalizability to LNs from diverse primary cancers. A DenseNet-121 ensemble model combining fixed-size cropping (FSC) and adjustable square cropping (ASC) was trained from ImageNet initialization on an axillary lymph node (ALN) dataset (n = 1,128 from 523 breast cancer patients). The model utilized clinical-implication-applied perinodal cropping with bicubic filtering and standardized resizing. To test cross-anatomical generalizability, an external dataset of 256 CT images across four anatomical regions was evaluated: cervical, mediastinal, upper-abdominal, and lower-abdominal LNs. Perinodal free margins were systematically varied from 10% to 40% to optimize the balance between context preservation and surround interference. Bicubic filtering and standardized resizing yielded the highest internal performance on the original ALN dataset (FSC-ASC ensemble area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUROC] 0.958, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.920-0.987 at 40% margin). The model demonstrated site-dependent, above-chance generalizability across all external regions. Cervical LNs achieved the highest performance at a 40% margin (AUROC 0.939, 95% CI 0.875-0.989). Mediastinal LNs peaked at a 10% margin (AUROC 0.796, 95% CI 0.672-0.903), with wider margins degrading performance due to adjacent structural interference. Upper-abdominal and lower-abdominal LNs reached optimal performance at a 30% margin (AUROC 0.814 for upper; AUROC 0.917 for lower). A single ALN-trained DL model can accurately predict LN metastasis across cervical, mediastinal, and abdominal stations through site-specific perinodal margin tuning. These findings support the feasibility of cross-cancer knowledge transfer and the clinical utility of generalizable backbones for pan-cancer nodal assessment.
zh_abstract: 淋巴结（LN）转移的评估对癌症分期和治疗计划至关重要。由于转移性LN的影像学特征在原发癌症之间共享，从某一解剖部位开发的基于计算机断层扫描（CT）的深度学习（DL）分类器可能迁移至其他部位。本研究使用应用临床含义的预处理构建了一个DenseNet-121集成模型，并评估其对不同原发癌症LN的跨解剖部位泛化性。一个结合固定尺寸裁剪（FSC）和可调方形裁剪（ASC）的DenseNet-121集成模型，从ImageNet初始化开始，在腋窝淋巴结（ALN）数据集（n = 1,128，来自523例乳腺癌患者）上训练。该模型采用应用临床含义的淋巴结周围裁剪，并结合双三次滤波和标准化调整尺寸。为检验跨解剖部位泛化性，评估了一个包含四个解剖区域共256张CT图像的外部数据集：颈部、纵隔、上腹部和下腹部LN。淋巴结周围自由边界从10%到40%系统变化，以优化背景保留与周围干扰之间的平衡。双三次滤波和标准化调整尺寸在原始ALN数据集上产生最高的内部性能（FSC-ASC集成在40%边界时的受试者工作特征曲线下面积[AUROC]为0.958，95%置信区间[CI] 0.920-0.987）。该模型在所有外部区域均表现出部位依赖性的、高于随机水平的泛化性。颈部LN在40%边界时达到最高性能（AUROC 0.939，95% CI 0.875-0.989）。纵隔LN在10%边界时达到峰值（AUROC 0.796，95% CI 0.672-0.903），更宽的边界因邻近结构干扰而降低性能。上腹部和下腹部LN在30%边界时达到最佳性能（上腹部AUROC 0.814；下腹部AUROC 0.917）。单一经ALN训练的DL模型通过部位特异性淋巴结周围边界调优，可准确预测颈部、纵隔和腹部各站LN转移。这些发现支持跨癌症知识迁移的可行性，以及可泛化骨干模型用于泛癌淋巴结评估的临床效用。

title: Evaluating uncertainty for detecting performance loss and guiding deferral after model transfer between hospital systems
zh_title: 模型跨院迁移后不确定性用于检测性能下降
summary: 预印本在MIMIC-IV训练三种神经网络做院内死亡预测，于eICU-CRD测试不确定性指标能否预警性能损失。
key_points: 熵与互信息均未能可靠反映性能下降
推迟熵最高20%可将剩余错误率降至6.3-8.0%
reason: 跨医院系统外部验证、结论有方法学价值，但为预印本且无临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Clinical prediction models often perform worse after transfer between hospital systems, but deterioration becomes apparent only once outcomes are known. We investigated whether uncertainty measures available at prediction time warn of performance loss and can help identify individual predictions requiring review. Three neural network architectures were trained on MIMIC-IV for in-hospital mortality prediction and evaluated on eICU-CRD. Measures included predictive entropy, mutual information from Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, and representation density. After transfer, AUROC fell from 0.86-0.87 to 0.76-0.77 and calibration worsened, while entropy and mutual information were lower. None of the measures reliably indicated the reduced performance. Deferring the 20% with the highest entropy reduced the remaining error rate from 17.5-20.1% to 6.3-8.0%; the deferred patients included 91-99% of false alarms but only 2-7% of missed deaths, which carried low uncertainty. Uncertainty therefore supported selective review but failed to reveal performance loss.
zh_abstract: 临床预测模型在医院系统之间迁移后往往表现更差，但性能下降只有在结局已知后才会显现。我们研究了预测时可得的不确定性度量是否能警示性能损失，并帮助识别需要复核的个体预测。我们在 MIMIC-IV 上训练了三种神经网络架构用于院内死亡预测，并在 eICU-CRD 上评估。度量包括预测熵、来自 Monte Carlo dropout 和 deep ensembles 的互信息，以及表示密度。迁移后，AUROC 从 0.86-0.87 降至 0.76-0.77，校准变差，而熵和互信息更低。没有任何度量能可靠指示性能下降。将熵最高的20%转交复核后，剩余错误率从17.5-20.1%降至6.3-8.0%；被转交复核的患者包括91-99%的假警报，但仅包括2-7%的漏报死亡，而这些漏报死亡具有低不确定性。因此，不确定性支持选择性复核，但未能揭示性能损失。

title: Rethinking Next-Visit Diagnosis Prediction Beyond Aggregate Metrics: Retrieval--Memory Multi-Agent Adjudication
zh_title: 超越聚合指标重新审视下次就诊诊断预测
summary: 预印本提出按分布、时间与病史深度分维度的评估框架，比较规则、LLM提示、检索、记忆与多智能体方法。
key_points: 提出多维度评估框架，替代单一聚合指标
重复上次就诊记录在整体上优于多数LLM方法
检索与记忆方法在不同时间转移场景下各有优势
reason: 预印本评估框架有新意且有基线对比，但无外部临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Next-visit diagnosis prediction forecasts the diagnoses documented at a patient's next encounter, turning retrospective electronic health records into prospective clinical prediction. However, conventional aggregate evaluation obscures its multifaceted nature: distributionally, models must handle variable-size diagnosis sets and long-tailed labels; temporally, they must distinguish persistent, newly recorded, and recurrent diagnoses; and both vary with observed history depth. We introduce an evaluation framework along these dimensions and apply it to rule-based heuristics, LLM-based prompting, retrieval, memory, and multi-agent approaches. This reveals that repeating the last visit outperforms most LLM-based approaches overall despite predicting no new or recurrent diagnoses, and that retrieval and memory exhibit distinct profiles whose relative strengths vary across temporal transitions and backbones. Motivated by this, we propose LONGINUS, a retrieval-memory multi-agent adjudication framework combining evidence retrieved from patient records with structured memory of the patient trajectory. Using cross-view agreement as a reliability heuristic, it preserves shared predictions and adjudicates disagreements without revealing their source. Across MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLM backbones, LONGINUS achieves the best transition-specific performance among LLM-based methods in nearly all settings while remaining competitive with them on aggregate metrics.
zh_abstract: 下一次就诊诊断预测预报患者下一次就诊时记录的诊断，将回顾性电子健康记录转化为前瞻性临床预测。然而，传统的聚合评估掩盖了其多面性：在分布上，模型必须处理可变大小的诊断集和长尾标签；在时间上，模型必须区分持续性、新记录和复发性诊断；且二者随观察到的病史深度而变化。我们引入一个沿这些维度的评估框架，并将其应用于基于规则的启发式方法、基于LLM的提示、检索、记忆和多智能体方法。这揭示出，重复上一次就诊在总体上优于大多数基于LLM的方法，尽管其不预测任何新发或复发性诊断；并且检索和记忆表现出不同特征，其相对优势随时间的转换和骨干模型而变化。受此启发，我们提出LONGINUS，一种检索-记忆多智能体裁决框架，结合从患者记录中检索的证据与患者轨迹的结构化记忆。使用跨视图一致性作为可靠性启发式，它保留共享预测并对分歧进行裁决而不揭示其来源。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，使用四个LLM骨干模型，LONGINUS在几乎所有设置中取得基于LLM方法中最佳的转换特异性性能，同时在聚合指标上保持与它们有竞争力。

title: Researchers Receive $4M NIH Grant to Build AI Model To Prevent Kidney Injury
